Name: Rahab
Summary: Rahab was a Canaanite woman in Jericho who hid Israel's spies and confessed faith in Israel's God. She was spared in Jericho's fall and became an ancestor of Jesus.
KeyStory: Rahab hid the spies under flax on her roof and hung a scarlet cord in her window, the sign by which her household was saved.
LifeLesson: Rahab's past did not disqualify her from God's future — she is in the family line of Jesus. No history is too broken for God to weave into redemption.
